To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the supplementation of standard wheat flour based biscuits with selected raw materials and dietary fibres resulted in the significant changes in nutritional and functional properties.

Supplementation of wheat flour based biscuits with selected raw materials (soy flour, amaranths, carob) and inulin (Raflin) resulted in significant changes in the nutritional parameters (protein content, protein digestibility, dietary fibre content) and in the antioxidative activity and total phenolic content of the samples.
the addition of raw materials and inulin into standard wheat flour based biscuit recipe significantly influenced the selected nutritional parameters and functional properties.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the possibility of improving the nutritive and functional value of biscuits by the use of selected raw materials and dietary fibres.
the development of nutritionally and functionically improved biscuits.
development of functional biscuits with improved nutritional and functional properties.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the incorporation of integral raw material and dietary fibre into the standard biscuit recipe has resulted in the significant improvement of nutritional quality of the product.
the incorporation of inulin into wheat flour based biscuits is a suitable way for improving their nutritional and functional characteristics.

the supplementation of standard wheat flour recipe with soy flour, amranth, carob fibre and oat fibre in combination with inulin is a promising approach to produce nutritionally and functionaly improved biscuits with increased protein content and digestability, dietary fibre, polyphenolic compounds and antioxidative activity.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
incorporation of integral raw material and inulin into the reference biscuit recipe resulted in the improvement of its nutritional and functional quality.

the incorporation of integral raw material and dietary fibre into the wheat flour based recipe resulted in the increase of nutritional and functional properties (proteins, dietary fibre, polyphenols, antioxidative activity) of modified biscuits.

the addition of soy flour, carob and oat fibre in combination with inulin to the reference sample resulted in the highest increase in the content of total dietary fibre, protein and protein digestibility.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the addition of raw materials and dietary fibres to the wheat flour based biscuit recipe may result in significant increase of protein digestibility and antioxidative activity, while the total energy value may be significantly decreased.

the incorporation of raw materials rich in proteins, dietary fibre, phenolic compounds, minerals, and inulin into the reference sample resulted in the development of nutritionally improved and functionally enhanced biscuits.

the incorporation of integral raw material and dietary fibre into wheat flour based biscuits is a promising way to improve the nutritional and functional properties, and consequently, to enhance the health benefits of these products.
